data.title: Preliminary building inquiry (Bauvoranfrage) for garden house rejected
data.summary: Stadt Beispielheim's building authority (Baurechtsamt) rejected the preliminary building inquiry of 12.01.2026 to construct a garden house with 42 m³ of enclosed space in the outdoor area (Außenbereich), citing § 35 Abs. 2 BauGB. A separate fee notice (Gebührenbescheid) for this decision will follow.
data.explanation: Stadt Beispielheim's building office (Baurechtsamt) has turned down your preliminary request (Bauvoranfrage) to build a garden house, saying it would harm public interests under building law (§ 35 BauGB) because it's in the outdoor/countryside area (Außenbereich). If you disagree, you can file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the city or the responsible objection authority by the deadline shown in the app. You'll also get a separate bill later for the processing fee. If you want to challenge this or explore other building options, it may help to talk to an architect or a lawyer specializing in building law (Baurecht).
